tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sam+bu ṭa'i dgongs pa dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun gyi mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal sam+bu ṭa'i dgongs pa dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun gyi mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen bde ba'i rol mtshos gang ba'i khyab bdag mtha' bral yod med lam gyi 'ching ba kun grol 'gyur med rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po gsal dang rnyog med chos kyi sku// dgyes pa'i gsang mdzod nges pa lnga ldan shes rab stong nyid rang mdangs rang shar kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rol pas mtshan dpe'i dra ba kun nas spel ba'i longs spyod rdzogs// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal thabs kyi bdag nyid sna tshogs sprul skus 'gro ba sgrol zhing mtshon cha 'bar bas nyon mongs dra ba kun bral gzhi dang rtsa bar 'gyur ba med phyir ngo bo nyid// zag med thugs kyi nges don lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun gyi kha sbyor gnyis med rol pa'i cho 'phrul 'di ga bde chen sku ste sku lnga longs spyod yongs rdzogs lha der 'dud// rang rig rig pa'i kye rdor rdo rje 'chang*// rang mdangs mdangs rtsal dkyil 'khor 'khor tshogs la| |rang snang snang ba'i mchod sprin sprin dkrigs ltar// rang mchod mchod pa'i dga' ston ston gyis nyon// 'di la gsum/ maṇ+ḍal sgrub pa/ de la mchod pa'i cho ga /rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ maṇ+ḍal gyi las rim dang*/ de sgrub pa dngos so// dang po ni/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i sgrub pa pos/ zla ba yar mar gyi tshes brgyad dam/ bcu 'am/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga/ nyer bdun/ gnam gang la sogs pa'i dus dge bar yo byad 'du byas la/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhes bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi ba byung lnga'i chu dang dri bzang gi chags chags btab cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas la/ slar yang rang*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūm̐ gis dri bzang g.yas skor du zlum por byugs nas chu gtsang gis lag pa bkrus/

rdor dril 'dzin pa'i thal mo snying khar phyes nas/ ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste// yang dag byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin// srog chags med par bsal ba bzod pa nyid// bya ba nye bar gnas pa brtson 'grus so// sems ni skad cig rtse gcig bsam gtan te// ri mo legs par bkra ba shes rab nyid// thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs par byas nas ni// pha rol phyin drug de rnams thob par 'gyur// 'di ni lus kyis las byas na// kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*// nad rnams kun las rnam par grol// lha dang mi las ches lhag cing*| |zla ba dang 'dra'i gzi brjid 'bar// nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs// rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa// mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid// ces phan yon dran pa'i ngang nas/ lag pa g.yas g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas sa gzhi der reg cing*/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos shing*/ oṃ hūm̐ kartā ri he badz+ra nā ma| zhes dbus dang*/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams so sor lha sngags mjug tu/ nā ma sbyar ba re re brjod cing*/ me tog gi tshom bu lha gnas ma 'chol bar bkod cing*/ rang gi mdun du dung chos kyi snod du spyi rgyud las/ gser dngul zangs dang rdo dang shing*// sar byas nya phyis dung dang ni// 'dam ma'i skyong bu zhal bsil dang*// bsang gtor mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// de'ang snod gzhan gang rung du/ zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ nas dang*/ 'o ma'i me tog dkar po/ ku sha/ til/ 'bras| yos/ 'di rnams la mchod yon gyi rdzas bdun du grags so// mchan/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ dri dkar po'i chu rnams blug pa'i mchod yon dang*/ dri zhim po'i chur me tog sna tshogs blugs pa'i zhabs bsil dang*/ dri bzang po'i chur ku sha'i 'thor g.yab btsugs pa rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis btab pa'i mdun du/

mi thub zla bas/ mdun du yang ni snod bzhag bya// mchan/ so so'i bzed zhal re re dang bcas pa rang gi g.yon des pas bstan to// nas dung chos kyi mdun maṇ+ḍal la phyogs par bshams/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha'i phyogs bzhir/ chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog sna tshogs pa dang*/ sbyar ba dang rang byung gi bdug spos/ spyi rgyud las/ sogs par khams sa la sogs pa'i// so ma btang ba'i kham phor bcu// byas nas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dang*// rgyab dang de bzhin mdun du'o// zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ dkar zhing gsal ba'i mar me/ gur gum dang*/ ga pur/ tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ dkar gsum mngar gsum zan dang sbags pa'i lha bshos/ thod ḍār dang*/ gsang ba'i rnge'u chung*/ cang te'u la sogs pa'i rol mo// dar zab kyi gos/ spyi rgyud las/ 'byor na lha ni thams cad la// ras ni zung re dbul bar bya// ma 'byor na yang rigs gsum gyi// bdag po rnams la zung re dbul// zhes pa'i don/ mchan/ zung rnams/ rab lha grangs mnyam pa/ 'bring ci 'byor ba dang*/ tha ma yang phyogs re rer tshar re dang*/ gzhan yang yol ba/ bla bre/ gtor ma la sogs sgrub mchod ltar bkod legs bsham mo// maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sra zhing mkhregs pa zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa zhes pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs ltar bsrung 'khor bsgom/ las thams cad pas bsangs/ shū n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas / mgo nang du phyogs pa re re dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur ces dang*/ dbus kyi gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sngon po zhabs bzhi sa la brdabs pas sogs nas/ 'od zer dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa 'i bar dang*/ shar du gau rī dkar mo sogs nas/ sgo ma bzhis bsrung ba'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs thugs rgyud bskul nas/

de dag thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gsal nas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes mos te/ rdor dril spos ring dang bcas pa thogs te/ oṃ/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med cing*// thabs shes gzugs brnyan sgyu ma'i skur ston pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ma lus 'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du// bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad cing*// dngos grub ma lus ji bzhin stsol mdzad ba'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ gtso bo'i zhal brgyad las sprul pa'i hūm̐ sgra zhes pa nas/ bum pa'i chus lus gang*/ bde ba thams cad chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur gyi bar dang*/ de nas gsang dbang sogs mi byed par chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// 'di dag ni mchod chog kho na'i dbang du byas kyi/ sgrub mchod dam bdag mdun sogs ras bris sam rdul tshon nam bum bskyed tshom bu sogs 'brel na dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar lha bskyed pa dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i mchod chog gi maṇ+ḍal mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ras bris sam/ rdul tshon nam/ bum bskyed sogs mchod pa'i cho ga la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ yan lag go// dang po la lnga/ phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang gi mchod pa/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ bstod pa/ mchod pa rnams so// dang po sgrub thabs kyi mchod pa ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te mchod par gyur

par mos te/ thal mo snying khar bzhag te/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// yid 'ong 'tsho byed ngom byed ro mi gsal| |bsil yang sla zhing sems gsal bdud rtsi mtshungs// nyi zla rlung gis reg par gyur pa yi// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod cing rdor dril thogs pa'i rnam lnga 'dod kor sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon gyi dung chos blangs te/ bzed zhal du sbreng ba'am de'i phyag rgya dang spro bsdu'i se gol bya'o// de nas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// gtsang ma'i chu las me tog kun sbags shing*// dri zhim ngad pa'i sman gyis rab bstar nas// rgyal ba'i sku la bsnyen bkur rnam dag phyir// zhabs bsil yo byad bzang po'i snod 'dzin ma/ mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥpā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lag g.yon zhabs bsil gyi snod du dung chos thogs la/ g.yas khu tshur de'i nang nas chu dang bcas pa'i me tog blangs la g.yas su lan gsum bskor mdzub mo nas rim gyis dkrol te/ bzed zhal du lan gsum dor bas lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs bkrus par bsam pa'am de 'dra'i phyag rgya bya'o// de nas sngar ltar/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i kun rtog dri ma rnams// kun nas sbyang phyir dri zhim ngad ldang ba// ku sha'i chun pos 'thor zhing dbul ba'i phyir// dri yi dung phor 'thor 'thung snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥprok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

g.yon 'thor 'thung gi snod dung chos thogs pas/ g.yas ku shas chu thigs blangs shing rdo rje khu tshur kha sbub pa mtha' nas dkrol zhing*| bzed zhal du lan gsum 'thor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing lha'i sku thams cad la 'thor bas dag par bsam mo// gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// chu dang thang skyes yid las byung ba yi// u duṃ pad+ma ut+pal la sogs pa'i// byang chub yan lag mdzes byed lo ma'i rgyan// me tog phreng ba ji snyed rab 'dzin pa'i// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥpuṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan pa'i mdzub mo dkrol bas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// kun nas sbyar dang rang bzhin rgyun byung ba// lha yi spos dang gzhan yang ngad ldang ba'i// a ka ru sogs bdug spos mchog ji snyed// kun tu dkrigs pa'i bdug spos rab 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥdhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ khu tshur gnyis kha 'og tu bstan pas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// gang zhig mun pa'i tshogs rnams nges 'joms pa// nyi ma dang ni zla ba rgyu skar dang*// snang gsal 'od ldan mar me'i phreng ba'i tshogs// rin chen kong bur bltams pa'i snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

khu tshur gyi mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs pas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// lhan cig skyes dang yongs su sbyar ba dang*// gur gum ga pur tsan+dan dkar dang dmar// rnam lnga dri yi byug pa sna tshogs pas// yongs su bkang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥgan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thal mo gyen du bslangs pa'i dri byug pa'i rgyas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// mngar skyur dang ni lan tshwa kha ba dang*// tsha ba dang ni bska ba'i ro ldan zhing*// nus pa brgyad dang zhu rjes gsum ldan pa'i// bza' ba dang bca' bshos gtsang snod 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥnai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thal mo gnyis kha steng du phyogs pa'i rgyas/ gzugs mdzes lang tsho rin chen rgyan spras shing*// chags pa'i nyams ldan rmad byung bde ba ster// 'jo sgeg mig 'phrul dga' ba'i dpal yon can// legs par zin pa'i lung ston sgra rnams dang*// ma zin lung du mi ston 'byung ba'i sgra// snyan dang mi snyan rol mo'i rnam pa tshogs// dbyar rnga bskyeng byed rol mo'i tshogs 'dzin ma// mkha' khyab sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par bgyi// oṃ shrī he badz+ra shas+t+ra dz+wa la grah+ṇaka sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥshapad pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra pra pañtsa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes rol mo dbul/ snang stong gzugs las sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// gzhon nu bzhin bzang 'dzum zhing lus sgeg pa'i// dngul dkar me long thogs pas mchod par bya| |gzugs snang gzugs kyi rdo rjer 'char bar shog / sngar gyi lha'i mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu/ rū pa= grag stong sgra las sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// gzhon nu bzhin bzang 'dzum zhing lus sgeg pa'i// sna tshogs rol mo thogs pas mchod par bya// sgrar snang sgra yi rdo rjer 'char bar shog /shapad= tshor stong dri las sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// gzhon nu bzhin bzang 'dzum zhing lus sgeg pa'i// dri bzang dung phor thogs pas mchod par bya// dri snang dri yi rdo rjer 'char bar shog /gan+dhe= myong stong ro las sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// gzhon nu bzhin bzang 'dzum zhing lus sgeg pa'i// ro brgya'i zas mchog thogs pas mchod par bya// ro snang ro yi rdo rjer 'char bar shog /ra sa= stong gsal reg byar sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs// gzhon nu bzhin bzang 'dzum zhing lus sgeg pa'i// 'jam gnyen gos bzang thogs pas mchod par bya// reg stong reg bya'i rdo rjer 'char bar shog /spar+she=

sogs rang gi sngags rgyas 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ gser las legs byung rtsibs stong ma nyams pa// drug cu rtsa bzhi rin chen rgyan gyis spras// dang po'i sa las nges par rgyal gyur pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// thal mo gyen du bslangs pa rgyab sprad la sor mo lnga gcig la gcig 'khyud de mthe bong gnyis lag pa'i mthil du bkug ste sbyar bas/ tsakra rat+na= rab gnas gangs ri lhun po'i rtse 'dra bar| |mche ba drug ldan yan lag stobs ldan zhing*// rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'phyo ba'i// glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag pa'i khu tshur la gung mo brkyangs pa cung zad bkug pa/ hasti rat+na= rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i spu ni yid 'ong ba'i// sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog gyur gang*// cang shes mgyogs 'gro kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i| |rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba'i gung mo dang ming med so sor sbyar te brkyang zhing mtheb bong gnyis bsgreng bas/ a shwa rat+na= dri med bai ḍūr las grub rin po che| |kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*// mun pa'i tshogs 'joms dgos 'dod kun stsol ba'i// nor bu rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i thal mo gshibs te rin po che ltar byas pa nor bu'i rgyas/ ma ṇi rat+na= /gang zhig reg bya dri gzugs kun ldan zhing*// mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba'i dpal ster ba'i// bud med dam pa rigs ldan rnams kyi mchog /btsun mo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mdzub mo gnyis dang gung mo gnyis mnyam pa'i tshigs su sbyar bas/ s+t+rī rat+na= gang zhig ser sna'i las kyi 'bras bu yis// gdung ba'i 'bul ba mtha' dag kun 'joms shing*// rnam thos bu yi 'byor pa'ang 'phrog byed pa'i// khyim bdag rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ gṛ ha pa ti rat+na= log pa'i dpung dang khengs dregs kun gzhom pa'i// 'gro dang gnas dang ldog par byed pa yi// ma lus dpung la mkhas pas rgyal byed pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// g.yon phub 'dzin cing g.yas ral gri 'debs pa'i rgyas/ pa ri ṇā ya ka rat+na= zhes rgyal srid bdun 'bul/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bgyi/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ= zhes dang*/ sngon tshe de bzhin gshegs la 'od 'chang sogs// skye bo rnams kyis bkra shis rdzas mchog rnams// ji ltar phul bzhin dkyil 'khor lha rnams la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ/ zhes 'bul/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i/ sngon mo pi wang snyan par bskul mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// g.yon pi wang 'dzin cing g.yas kyi sor mos rgyud bskul ba'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ser mo yid 'ong gling bu bsgyur mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// sor mos gling bu bsgyur tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dmar mo rnga zlum brjid ldan bskul mdzad ma| |mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// lag gnyis rnga kha gyen bstan rdung tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ljang mo rdza rnga 'jigs par rdung mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod//

lag gnyis rnga 'phred bstan rdung tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dmar skya bzhad ldan bzhad pa'i tshul mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// khu tshur gnyis kha thur du sbubs pa kha 'gram du bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// sngon mo sgeg cing 'gying ba'i nyams mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// khu tshur gnyis dkur brten nas/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ser mo ting shag dkrol zhing glu len ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis ting shag dkrol ba'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ljang gu gar gyi rol rtsed bsgyur mdzad ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// thal mo gnyis kha sgyur tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dkar mo sna tshogs me tog phreng mdzes ma| |mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// me tog ma'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// mthing ga dri zhim bdug pa'i spos 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// spos kyi rgyas/

oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dmar mo 'od 'bar snang gsal mchog 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// mar me'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ljang gu dri bzang chu'i snod 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// dri'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dkar mo gsal dwangs me long rab 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// gzugs ma'i rgyas/ oṃ rū pa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dmar mo ro brgya bdud rtsi'i bshos 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// ro ma'i rgyas/ oṃ ra sa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// ljang gu srab 'jam rnam bkra'i gos 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// reg bya'i rgyas/ oṃ spar+she badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan rmad byung bde ster ba'i// dkar mo chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog 'dzin ma// mkha' mnyam tshogs sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// rdo rje bsdams pa las mtheb mdzub mthe'u chung rnams so sor rtse sprad pa'i rgyas/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dbul/ de nas/ rdo rje rigs kyi mchog gyur pa// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas rnams la// rtag tu rnam pa thams cad du// bdag nyid dad pas dbul bar bgyi// theg chen lam la brtan bya'i phyir// he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor du// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pas// rim pa gnyis la bslab par bgyi//

zhes bdag 'bul zhing lam brtan bya'o// 'di rnams ni bum dbang dang 'brel pa'i mchod pa'o// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ byin rlabs zin pa'i bdud rtsi'i thod pa g.yas kyis thogs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba yum dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin gyi// dri chen dri chu rak+ta byang chub sems// sha chen ba lang khyi dang glang po che// rta yi sha rnams sbyang spel bsgyur ba las// dri med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rab dwangs bas// rmad byung kha dog dri ro nus ldan pa'i// mkha' mnyam thod pa bkang te lha rnams mchod// zag med bde ba chen pos dgyes par mdzod| | ces dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas/ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis sgrub thabs ltar nang mchod phul la/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis| |ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo dkar mo ni// dung mdog phyag gnyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// rdo rje thogs te mda' 'phen pa'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gau rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo chom rkun ma// dmar mo rdo rje lcags kyu mchog 'dzin ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon khu tshur las mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tsau rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo ro langs ma// ser mo ral gri chang gi snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas kyi mdzub mo dang gung mo brkyangs pa ral gri'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje'i khu tshur kha phye ba gyen du bstan la thod pa 'dzin pa'i rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra be tā lī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo za phod ma| |ljang gu sbrul dang me thab 'dzin mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas sdigs mdzub dang g.yon khu tshur kha phye ba gyen du bstan la thod pa 'dzin pa'i rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ghasma rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo sbos mo ni// ser mo sha chen dpag bsam shing 'dzin ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// lag g.yas khu tshur steng du bstan pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puk+ka sī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo ri khrod ma// dkar mo byang sems snod dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas steng du kha bstan pa thod pa 'dzin tshul dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dkur brten pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sha wa rī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo gtum mo ni// sngo sangs stag dang pad+ma dkar po 'dzin// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas thod pa thogs pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon mtheb mdzub sbyar bas pad+ma'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tsan+ḍa lī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis| |ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo g.yung mo ni// chang gi snod dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa thogs// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// lag gnyis thod pa re re bzung ba'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bhi nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo gling bu ma// dmar mo snyan pa'i gling bu bsgyur mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod//

gling bu 'bud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra waṃ she ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo pi wang ma// ser mo pi wang sor mos bskul mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// pi wang bskul ba'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra wī ṇi ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis| |ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo rnga chen ma// dmar mo rnga chen 'brug ltar sgrog mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// rnga kha gyen bstan rdung ba'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra mu kuṇ+ḍa ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo rdza rnga ma// ljang mo rdza rnga kun nas dkrol mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// rnga kha 'phred bstan dkrol ba'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra mu rañdze ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo rta gdong ma| |nag mo lcags kyus kun nas 'gugs mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// lag g.yas lcags kyu'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a shwa mu kha ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo phag gdong ma// ser mo zhags pas yongs su bcings mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas sdigs mdzub zhags pa thogs pa'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra bā rā ha mu kha ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha ma ོ khyi gdong ma/ /dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs nas sdom mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzub lcags sgrog thogs pa'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra shwa na mu kha ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha mo seng gdong ma// ljang gu dril bus yongs su myos mdzad ma// nam mkha' bkang ste dgyes pa rdo rje mchod// g.yas dril bu nam mkhar phyar zhing*| oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra singha mu kha ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sbyar la mchod/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi// rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar byung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog |oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing*// lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni// nges par bsregs pa de yi spos// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// dhū paṃ= yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu 'bar// mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// dī paṃ= bde ba chen po'i gzhi la gnas// byang chub sems ni 'das pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byug pa dag /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// gan+dhaṃ= 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod// dbang po thams cad yang dag brten// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rjer// bza' ba'i snod du mchod par bya// nai wi d+yaṃ= rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyar// zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*// rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// shapad=

zhes nang gi nyer spyod lnga dang*/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi la gnas// yid 'phrog 'dzum sgeg lus phra 'ja' tshon 'dra'i// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dga' ma'i 'jo sgeg snyan tshig chags pa'i gtam// shī shī'i sgra dang tsum+ba na yi sgra// phyag rgya rnam lnga glu dbyangs ci mchis pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// shapad= lus kyi dri dang bha gar gnas pa'i dri// kha ru gnas pa'i ut+pal dri la sogs// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i dri mchog ci mchis pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// gan+dhe= bim+pa ltar dmar ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi dang*// lce 'jib la sogs bde ba kun gyi ro// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i ro mchog ci mchis pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// ra sa = gnas dgur reg dang mchod cing bzhin spro dang*// rdo rje pad+mar reg cing sbyor ba sogs// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i reg bya ci mchis pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// spar+she= zhes pa nang gi 'dod yon lnga 'bul lo// 'di dag gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa'o// gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ gzugs mchog gzhon sha sgeg cing yid 'ong shing*// bcu drug na tshod lus phra rin chen rgyan// rjes chags 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa// g.yung mo'i snyoms 'jug bde bas mchod par bya// 'dzag med bde ba'i mchod yon dang*// bde bar 'khrid pa'i zhabs bsil mchog /byang sems gsang ba'i 'thor 'thung dang*// yid 'ong nyi ma'i me tog nyid// ral ba med pa'i tshul khrim spos// bde gsal brtan pa mar me yin// bde ba tshul khrims dri yi mchog /lus ngag yid gsum tshim byed pa'i// ting 'dzin zas te zhal zas mchog

/'jam snyan tshim par smra ba dang*// rang srog sgra ni sil snyan sgra// gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di dag 'bul// lha rnams bde bas mnyes par mdzod// gtso bo dang bdag med ma lha mo brgyad rol cha ma bzhi sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa rnam par gyur pa las/ g.yung mor 'khyud cing 'o byed pa dang*/ bsrub pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa sogs 'khyud pa'i rgyas nga rgyal bzung ngo*// slar yang mchod lha rnams lha so so'i rang mdangs kyi rnam par gyur/ ces pa 'di ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa'o// bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// gang tshe tha dad mi dmigs par| |de 'di mchod pa chen po ste// bla med mchod pa'i mchod pas mchod// ces dang*/ yang*/ rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa// gzung 'dzin yod med lam dang bral// thams cad mtshan ma'i yul las 'das// snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sku// rang rig dgyes pa rdo rje nyid// mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// kun / ces pa'am/ yang na/ hūm̐ don zab sngags kyis sbyangs pa'i rang rtsal las// rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur dra bas sbrel// 'khor lo rtsibs bcur khro bcus bgegs dpung 'joms// mi mthun srung mdzad bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bstod// phyi nang chos kun ngo bo dbyer med pa'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung nam mkha' sa gzhi dang*// rgya mtsho me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor shar// pho brang 'degs byed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam snang rang bzhin rin chen gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rgyan dang ldan// gsal stong 'dzin med dbang po'i gzha' tshon 'dra// thar pa'i grong khyer mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan phreng ba dang*| |dpag bsam shing dang rgyal srid 'byor pa'i tshogs// stegs bur lha mo bcu drug gis mtshon pa'i// 'dod yon ma spang gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod// de phyir tshogs brgyad gnas dag me ri dang*// rdo rje'i rwa ba dur khrod chen po brgyad// der gnas me chu shing dang mchod rten sprin// phyogs skyong lha klu rnal 'byor ma la bstod// de nang mtshan bzang so gnyis ngo bo nyid// sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma sum cu gnyis// lte bar ze'u 'bru chos 'byung re khas mtshan// rnam dag 'khor yug rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhal med khang pa dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i// phyogs kyi mdog can nang du gru chad steng*// sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar mu khyud bcas// bkod legs sprul pa'i rnam pa la phyag 'tshal// pad+ma'i lte bar nam mkha'i nor bu'i steng*// phung sogs bdud bzhi'i ngo bo lhan skyes bzhi// gan rkyal phyogs pa'i steng du thod khrag dang*// chu shel dbang por bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dab brgyad sna tshogs pad steng zla ba'i dal// gru chad zur bzhi pad+ma thod khrag dang*// zla ba'i gdan bcas sgo bzhir chu skyes steng*// thod khrag dbugs bral gdan bcas la phyag 'tshal| |dbus kyi gdan steng zla nyi'i dkyil 'khor la// dbyangs gsal gyis mtshan bar du sa bon gnyis// 'bar 'dzag snyoms 'jug yongs su gyur pa las// mngon par byang chub lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod// de las bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung gtso// he ru ka dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mchog

/lha dang lha min sdig khros mthing nag sku// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus zhal nag cing drag /steng zhal dud mdog rgyab zhal mthing nag cing*// kun kyang 'gyings// bde stong dbyer med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das kyis bde chen sbyor bzhed pa'i// sprul pa'i lha mo dpag med sngo bsangs ma// g.yas pa gri gug phyar stabs bgegs dpung 'joms// g.yon pas thod khrag mgul 'khyud la phyag 'tshal// khro gnyer spyan gsum mche gtsigs ral pa brdzes// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal gcer bur 'gyings// phyag rgya lngas brgyan g.yas zhabs yab la 'khril// / ces bstod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra sogs kyi nga rgyal bzung ngo*// yang bdag mdun bum pa sogs mchod pa mi zlos par 'dod na/ gzhan nas kyang kha 'gengs par rung la/ 'on kyang mchod phreng zlos pa la skyon med do// dper na nyi ma mang po dang 'brel ba'i sgrub mchod yin na cho ga dngos kyang zlos dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa yan lag la gnyis/ gtor ma dang*/ tshogs 'khor ro// dang po gtor ma ni/ sgrub thabs kyi thun mtshams ltar phyi nang gi gtor chog gis 'bul lo// 'dir gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mchod chog kho na'i dbang du byas pas/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor du bshad pa ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'du bar 'os pa dag khrus byas te sgrub gang gi sgo drung du sgo'i phyi rol du sgo srung gi cha lugs byas pa dag la/

kyai/ khro bo sngon po mdzes pa ste// khyod ni dam tshig yid du 'ong*// nor bu rin chen gyis bcings pa'i// dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa kye// bdag ni 'khor ba las bsgral phyir// dpa' bos gnang gi bstan du gsol// rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su// bzang po'i sgo 'di phye ste mthong*// zhes gsol te sgo dbye la brda'i lan byas la gral la 'khod/ dkyil chog dang ma 'brel bar tshogs 'khor bya bar spro na/ skabs 'dir lha'i rnal 'byor bya dgos so// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du byas te stan gyi steng du bshams pa la bdud rtsis bran la/ sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas tshogs phud tshal pa zhig dang tshogs rdzas kun gyi phud bsdus pa/ dkyil 'khor ram ras bris sku sogs kyi mdun du phul la bdud rtsis bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ mgron rnams ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas zag med bde bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur| mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ dza ya badz+ra dhṛka /badz+ra yo gi nī/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ bi khyā ta de ba/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/ paṇ+ḍi ta bhū mi shrī/ bi ma la shrī bha dra/ lo tsā ba bo dhi singha/ mañdzu gho ṣa kīrti/ dharma swa mi sarba dz+nyā/ ma ti ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ ku mā ra ma ti/ ā nan+da bha dra/ gu ṇa shrī/ gu ru dh+wa dza/ rak+ta mu ku ṭa dha ra dharma kīrti/ paṇ+ḍiten+d+ra/ shī le shwa ra/ ar+ṣa mā lā/ rat+na bhak+ta/ badz+re shwa ren+d+ra/ dharme shwa rā ya ga ṇa tsakra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams dang*/ de nas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+rā ya ga ṇa tsakra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/
